answer: One threshold for every key: Horn layer horn blank proof turned on the comb makers' court, and one receipt, each horn blank is a measured horn yield plus a hornworker's signature, no matter whose hand carries it. One jetty proves a maker, one comet proves a payment, one wander proves a wait — and a wait is the one thing a printer cannot paint. No single shop can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three keepers who never meet. The door takes payment, not promises: the farm pays 63217 POA while one agent pays 77.
